## Zoning & Development Analysis — 6247 N Rockwell St, Chicago IL
**PIN: 13012120090000 | Lincoln Square (Community Area 4)**

---

### 1. Zoning District in Effect

This parcel is zoned **RS-2** (Residential Single-Unit, Detached House District) [5]. RS-2 is the middle tier of the three single-family RS districts, differentiated from RS-1 and RS-3 primarily by minimum lot area requirements and floor area ratios [5]. You can verify this on the [Chicago Zoning Map](https://gisapps.chicago.gov/ZoningMapWeb/?liab=1&config=zoning).

**Confidence: High** — the classification comes directly from the City's official GIS system.

---

### 2. Can I Build a Two-Flat (Two Dwelling Units)?

**Almost certainly not as of right under RS-2.** RS-2 is a single-unit detached house district; its primary purpose is to accommodate detached houses on individual lots [5]. A two-flat would require either:

- **Rezoning to RS-3, RT3.5, or higher**, or
- **Invoking the RS-3 "Predominance of the Block" exemption** [2] — but that exemption is explicitly limited to RS-3 lots, not RS-2. Because this parcel is zoned RS-2, that exemption does not apply here.

**What I could not determine:** The specific minimum lot area per unit for RS-2 (the full table from [2] was not returned in the context). The code confirms that RS-3 allows a potential reduction to 1,500 sq ft per unit under certain block-predominance conditions [2], but RS-2 imposes stricter standards that would need to be looked up in the full [2] table. Given your lot size of 4,125 sq ft, even if RS-2 allowed two units, you'd need to confirm the applicable per-unit threshold.

**Confidence: High that RS-2 prohibits two-flats as of right; moderate on the exact numerical threshold.**

---

### 3. Key Bulk and Density Standards

The context returned the district purpose language [5] and partial density rules [2] but **did not include the complete RS-2 bulk standards table** (FAR, height limits, setbacks, and exact minimum lot area per unit). What can be stated:

- **Minimum lot area per unit (RS-3 reference):** [2] sets a floor of 1,500 sq ft per unit in RS-3 under specific block-predominance conditions — RS-2 is more restrictive.
- **Parking location rule:** Off-street parking is prohibited in side setbacks and within 20 feet of the front property line in RS districts [3]. Required parking must be on the same zoning lot as the dwelling units served [3].
- **Lot size on record:** 4,125 sq ft (per Cook County Assessor). Building footprint: 1,622 sq ft (1 story, built 1927).

**To get the complete RS-2 bulk table** (FAR, height, setbacks), consult the full text of §§ 17-2-0400 and 17-2-0500 of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, or use the [Chicago Zoning Map](https://gisapps.chicago.gov/ZoningMapWeb/?liab=1&config=zoning) and the Department of Zoning & Development's zoning tables at [chicago.gov/zoning](https://www.chicago.gov/city/en/depts/dcd/supp_info/zoning_ordinance.html).

**Confidence: Partial** — parking location rules confirmed [3]; full bulk table was not available in the returned context.

### 5. Parking Requirement and Transit-Related Reduction

Per [3], in RS districts:
- Off-street parking must be located **on the same zoning lot** as the dwelling units served.
- Parking is **prohibited in side setbacks** and **within 20 feet of the front property line**, but may be placed in a required side setback if accessed by a permitted driveway from the front.
- Nonresidential parking (e.g., religious assembly) may be located off-site only with **special use approval**, with a maximum 600-foot distance [3].

**Transit-related parking reduction:** Because this parcel is **not in a TOD area**, no automatic parking reductions apply. The property currently has a 1-car garage on record.

**The specific number of required spaces for a single-family residence in RS-2** is in the parking demand table of § 17-10-0200, which was not returned in full — verify directly in the ordinance or with the Zoning Department.

**Confidence: High on location rules [3]; moderate on exact required space count.**

---

### 6. Coach House / ADU on This Lot?

**Not currently permitted under the ADU Pilot Program.** This parcel is **not in an ADU-Allowed RS Area** per the regulatory data. The ADU overlay program under [1] only applies to designated pilot areas, and this lot is not one of them.

Under the base zoning ordinance [4]:
- A building permit for a new coach house in an RS-zoned lot **may not be issued unless it complies with § 17-7-0570** [4].
- Since this lot is not in an ADU-Allowed RS Area [1], a new coach house unit cannot be permitted.
- Even if the overlay applied, coach houses may not exceed **22 feet in height** [4], must provide at least **3 feet of open, unobstructed side clearance** (except where abutting an alley or street) [4], and must be located in conformance with rear setback rules [4].

**Conversion ADUs** (interior basement/attic units) are similarly governed by [1] and would require the property to be in a designated ADU area.

**Confidence: High that an ADU/coach house is not currently permitted here.**
